set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/archive-member-safety
sh -n "$base/bin/unpack"
mkdir -p "$base/incoming"
if find "$base/incoming" -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: incoming was not initially empty' >&2; exit 1; fi
for pkg in absolute traversal symlink; do
    set +e
    output=$("$base/bin/unpack" "$base/packages/$pkg.tar" 2>&1)
    rc=$?
    set -e
    printf 'RESULT package=%s rc=%s message=%s\n' "$pkg" "$rc" "$output"
    [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]
    if find "$base/incoming" -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then
        printf 'ERROR: rejected package %s installed a member\n' "$pkg" >&2
        find "$base/incoming" -mindepth 1 -printf '%P -> %l\n' >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done
[ ! -e /outside.txt ]
